description:
This package allows the GDPR encryption and decryption for EF core 3.1 or higher tow encrypt data in
			the database on databases that are not enabled for data encryption. This package was made for data hosted on servers where no one but the
			application (or other applications that share the same encryption key) to be able to read and write the data
